text: Web3 may not yet be ready for a truly decentralized organization: across platforms there is always a promise of decentralization, yet tangible measures prevent that promise from becoming true.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Josh Bykowski, Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAO) – A Market Meta Analysis (2023). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4529715

isBasedOn.name: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAO) – A Market Meta Analysis

abstract: Despite that ideation, it seems Web3 may not be ready for a truly decentralized organization just yet. There is an overarching theme between platforms in which there is always a promise of decentralization, yet tangible measures prevent that from becoming true.
